messages.author: beac4160dfd94c6e
messages.subject: Bayesian logistic regression
parts:
Hi all, 

I currently am new to INLA and am trying to run a Bayesian model but am trying to figure out this error. it has a lot of fixed effects (and is sensitivity analysis to a frequentist model that is plagued by separation problems). The outcome is rare (about ~2%).  I still get results, but don't know if they are valid. 

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
finalprepostdataset3<-finalprepostdataset3%>%
  mutate(id=as.factor(id))
sink("./Analysis.txt", append=T, split=T)
formula1<-icucrowded2 ~ factor(x1) + factor(x2)+ factor(x1_x2) + x3 + x4 + x4+ id
finalprepostdataset4<-as.data.table(finalprepostdataset3)
inla.setOption(num.threads = 8)
result <- inla(formula1, data = finalprepostdataset4, family = "binomial")
summary(result)
*** warning *** delta[0] is NAN, 'vb.correction' is aborted *** Please (re-)consider your model, priors, confounding, etc.
Thanks,

Joseph

I need to rerun it here to check: please share data/code
